slots.headline: Why Matcha Now?
slots.subtitle: The green tea that's more than a trend.

slots.title: What Is Matcha?
slots.body: Stone-ground shade-grown green tea leaves. One cup delivers focused energy without the jitters. It’s the ritual your morning deserves.

slots.title: Centuries In The Making
slots.body: Monks in Japan have sipped matcha since the 12th century. They used it to stay alert during long meditations. Today, that calm focus is yours.

slots.title: Packed With Antioxidants
slots.body: Matcha boasts 137 times the antioxidants of regular green tea. It supports metabolism, skin clarity, and steady energy. Drink it daily.

slots.title: A Moment Of Calm
slots.body: Whisking matcha slows time. The warm foam and earthy aroma ground you before the day begins. Small ritual, big shift.

slots.title: Crafted In The Shade
slots.body: Tencha leaves are shaded for 20 days to boost chlorophyll. Then they are steamed, dried, and ground to a fine jade powder. Quality you can taste.

slots.title: Beyond The Latte
slots.body: Add it to oats, smoothies, or face masks. Matcha fits modern routines without losing its soul. Trendy? Yes. Timeless? Absolutely.

slots.headline: Ready To Start?
slots.body: Shop our ceremonial-grade matcha and upgrade your mornings.
